questions.question: When Esau planned to kill his brother Jacob, Jacob's mother Rebekah told Jacob to flee to whom?
Before Jacob left home, what command about marriage did his father Isaac give him?

answers.text: Don't marry until Esau forgives you
Marry before your mother sends for you

questions.question: While Jacob slept on a stone far from home, he dreamed of what resting on the earth and reaching up to heaven?
When Jacob fled from his brother Esau, what did the LORD promise him in a dream?

answers.text: To be with him and bring him back
To make the road short and easy
To soften Esau's heart right away
